missionSettings.description: FAULT LINE 3/5 - NORTH SEA. Stalled on land, the South goes around. An assault group with two assault carriers comes in from the west to land at Westende and take Ostend-Bruges airport, the North's window on the sea. The North has a small squadron off Zeebrugge, beach defences and a reserve in Bruges. SOUTH: capture Ostend-Bruges. NORTH: sink both assault carriers, and the landing craft before they reach the beach. Both sides playable: PvP, or co-op against the AI. Requires NOCustomMaps and the Belgica map (Nuclear Option Mod Manager). Fictional scenario: North = Boscali, South = Primeva. No nuclear weapons.
